energy_path.stage: Pressure arrives as hard external demands
energy_path.mechanism: Seven Killings carries a moderate but constant load (four), hidden in Yin and Si, so demands keep landing on you from authorities, deadlines, and standards without a visible single source you can push back on.

Killings-type pressure feeds the heaviest force in this chart, the indirect resource (ten), which appears openly as the month stem Wu earth and hides in Yin, Chen, and Si. Because the Geng day master is balanced and favors earth, this intake recharges rather than floods you, so each demand becomes deeper private mastery at low energy cost.

The expression channel is nearly dry: the eating-god type sits at zero, hurting officer at two, and no water appears in the visible eight characters. Finished understanding stays inside; nothing carries it outward, so the energy gained in study stops here instead of converting into credit, influence, or new opportunity.

Direct wealth at six (year stem Yi, hidden in Chen) plus peer-type forces also at six (hour stem Xin, year branch Chou) means you secure salary, savings, and a stable position by defining exactly what is yours and never dropping it. With the balanced day master favoring metal and earth, this defense runs cheaply and steadily builds reserves.

The peer-and-wealth forces running at equal weight mean colleagues keep reaching for the same credit and budgets. Because your work is invisible by the mechanism above, whoever speaks first converts your understanding into their visibility, which regenerates the pressure that started the loop.

leverage.point: Attaching one visible artifact to every deep dive
leverage.input: Two hours of packaging per completed study: a short document, a demo, or a brief talk carrying your name.
leverage.output: Each artifact converts already-finished private mastery into recognized standing, which then protects your income and position directly — the defense loop currently fed by effort alone gets fed by reputation instead.
leverage.why: The intake side runs at full power — indirect resource at ten with a balanced day master that absorbs it — while the exit side is the driest point in the chart, hurting officer barely present and the eating-god type empty. Input added at the driest point moves the most: the knowledge already exists, so the only missing step is the outward form. The current luck stretch beginning at thirty-eight introduces Ren water, the one element the visible chart lacks, so sustaining this output habit costs less effort now than in the metal-heavy decades before it.

vulnerability.point: A sealed container under continuous load
vulnerability.condition: This structure grinds down when two things run together: demand stays high (Seven Killings hidden in Yin and Si keeps feeding) and the environment rewards the fastest voice — peers racing openly for the same credit, which the equal peer-and-wealth weighting makes your default workplace experience.
vulnerability.mechanism: Pressure flows into study, study restores you, but with no water in the visible characters and the expression channel nearly dry, the load has no outward exit. The cycle repeats silently: demand in, mastery banked, credit taken by whoever spoke, more demand. Because the resource intake genuinely recharges you and the wealth side keeps finances stable, nothing looks wrong from outside — the wear shows only as you going quieter and studying more instead of asking for relief, until exhaustion arrives as withdrawal rather than complaint.
vulnerability.self_check: Check one signal monthly: count artifacts you produced that someone else saw. If the count stays at zero while your private notes keep growing, the loop is sealed and running on reserves. A second check: if you cannot remember the last time you asked anyone for help, the self-sufficiency has stopped being a strength and started being the lid.

upgrade_path.entry_condition: You accept one structural fact: the intake is not the problem, the exit is. You begin the moment you watch someone present a conclusion you reached weeks earlier and correctly.
upgrade_path.work: After every deep dive, spend two fixed hours producing one outward artifact — a short writeup, a demo, a recorded explanation. Attach your name. Do this regardless of whether anyone asked; the rule is one dive, one artifact, no exceptions.
upgrade_path.done_signal: A colleague cites your document back to you in a meeting without being prompted, or someone asks you to explain something because they found the artifact rather than because a crisis forced you.

upgrade_path.entry_condition: You have at least three named artifacts in circulation and the habit of producing them holds without internal argument.
upgrade_path.work: Where you currently guard ground silently (Rob Wealth and Direct Wealth at equal weight make this your reflex), state terms out loud instead: which part is yours, what the other party owes, what happens on underdelivery. Practice one explicit credit claim per project — 'that mechanism came from my writeup' — stated plainly, not argued.
upgrade_path.done_signal: A peer collaboration completes where your share of the result is written down and acknowledged before the work starts, and you felt no need to over-prepare a private fallback.

upgrade_path.phase: Ride the water stretch at scale
upgrade_path.entry_condition: The luck pillar starting at thirty-eight has arrived and the first two phases are running as habits, not projects.
upgrade_path.work: Move from artifacts to systems of expression: a running body of writing, a teaching or mentoring role, a standard or process others adopt. Water — the element the visible chart entirely lacks — now flows through the luck pillar, so channel banked mastery into formats that keep working without your presence, and choose environments that pay for verified depth: audit trails, standards, long-cycle clients.
upgrade_path.done_signal: People you have never met use your material and your name travels without you carrying it; pressure still arrives, but it now routes through your documented work instead of through private midnight study.
